description.en: Session Steward (merged package): archive browsing & cleanup, a four-gate session health checkup with reversible prescriptions, plus an independent FTS5 content-search index (title/content modes, incremental sync, non-destructive rebuild, snapshot export/import). Never rewrites session logs.
description.zh: 会话管家（合并包）：归档浏览与清理、四门体检（可逆处方），外加独立 FTS5 会话内容搜索（标题/内容双模式、增量同步、非破坏性整理、快照导入导出）。不改写会话日志。
